title: Settings JSON authority persistence
summary: Moved desktop Settings persistence to a versioned JSON authority with generated PSD1 projection, explicit PSD1 import recovery routes, workspace persistence evidence, alias/legacy-extra migration, rollback-safe save promotion, and PowerShell projection-manifest validation.
reason: The editable PSD1 was too fragile as the silent authority: refactors and new settings could make operator values appear lost or make tests pass against defaults. JSON authority preserves canonical values, reports drift/migrations, and forces explicit recovery instead of silent fallback.
behavior_before: The backend loaded and saved the active PSD1 directly. Later manual PSD1 drift, missing keys, renamed keys, or import failures could look like defaults or lost settings, and PowerShell startup did not verify whether the PSD1 matched a backend-generated projection.
behavior_after: The backend loads `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MediaPipelineRemuxEncodeAIO\settings.v1.json` when present, imports the PSD1 only for first-run or explicit recovery, saves JSON plus PSD1 projection as one validated transaction, preserves unknown imported keys as inert legacy extras, exposes store/projection/drift evidence in Settings workspace, and blocks PowerShell startup when a matching projection manifest shows stale PSD1 drift.
tests_added: Added tests/python/desktop/test_settings_store.py covering first-run PSD1 import to JSON, existing JSON winning over PSD1 drift, invalid JSON restore/block behavior, save rollback, key aliases, legacy extras, case-duplicate rejection, and import preview.
Extended ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-ConfigKeyRegistryChecks.ps1 with fresh/stale projection manifest checks.
Extended tests/python/desktop/test_api_command_contracts.py for Settings PSD1 import preview/apply route contracts and strict confirm_import validation.
Extended tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_settings_patch.py to assert Settings save delegates to JSON authority when available and PSD1 import apply requires literal confirm_import.
Extended tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_settings_workspace.py to assert JSON authority, projection, migration, legacy-extra, and drift evidence in Settings workspace.

rollback_plan: Revert the JSON settings store service, service/facade/API route wiring, workspace DTO metadata fields, PowerShell projection-manifest validation, tests, fixtures, docs, inventories, and generated summaries in this packet. This restores PSD1-direct persistence and removes the new import routes without touching source media, queue state, pending publish manifests, rename state, or media policy.
